title: AVIATION MANAGEMENT
utme_requirements: The UTME subject combinations for the programme are English Language, Mathematics, Economics in addition to one of either Commerce or Geography or Government or Principles of Accounts.
de_requirements: For the three-year Direct Entry into 200 level, candidate must in addition to having five (5) O-level SSCE or NECO credits, obtain at least two (2) subjects passes in relevant subjects at Advance GCE Level (or its equivalent) passes in relevant subjects, or OND with credit level passes or a good university degree may be considered. Holder of at least upper credit level at HND are eligible for consideration for admission into 300 level.
subjects: For the four-year UTME Entry into 100 level, candidate must in addition to having an acceptable UTME score, obtain five (5) O-level SSCE or NECO credits, in the relevant subject at not more than two (2) sittings. The subjects must include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and other acceptable subjects.

title: POLITICS, PHILOSOPHY & ECONOMICS
utme_requirements: The UTME subject combinations for the programme are English Language, Economics, Government/History in addition to one of either Arts or Social sciences.
de_requirements: For the three-year Direct Entry into 200 level, candidate must in addition to having five (5) O-level SSCE or NECO credits, obtain at least two (2) subjects passes at Advance GCE Level (or its equivalent) in relevant subjects which could include Government or History or Economics or Philosophy, or OND with credit level passes related to the programme may be considered.
subjects: For the four-year UTME Entry into 100 level, candidate must in addition to having an acceptable UTME score, obtain five (5) O-level SSCE or NECO credits, in the relevant subject at not more than two (2) sittings. The subjects must include English Language, Mathematics and other three acceptable subjects from Arts or Social sciences.
